patthana8.67:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na na kāmācaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.67:2.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.67:3.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ ca na na kāmāvacaraṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
